changelog:
### 🤖 Android Release (v2.4.1)
• **Synced Live Lyrics:** Real-time streaming synchronized lyrics alongside playback
• **Spotify Playlist Import:** Import any public Spotify playlist directly via share link
• **Offline Audio:** High-quality offline song and playlist downloads with zero ads
• **Equalizer & Audio FX:** Customizable equalizer with bass boost presets
• **21+ Languages:** Localized interface and curated music in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and more

### 🍎 iOS Release (v2.4.1)
• **Cross-Platform Debut:** Full iOS package for iPhone and iPad via Sideloadly, AltStore, & TrollStore
• **Lock Screen & Background Audio:** Native lock-screen controls and continuous playback
• **Synced Live Lyrics:** Real-time synchronized lyrics on iPhone and iPad
• **Spotify Playlist Import:** Convert and stream any public Spotify playlist directly
• **Zero Ads & Unlimited Skips:** Full premium music experience without subscriptions
